title: Exploration strategies for Gaussian process bandit optimization with inference regret guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2610.16187v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing cumulative regret guarantees for Bayesian optimization (BO) do not necessarily characterize the quality of the algorithm's final output. This gap is critical under noisy evaluations, where the goal is to return a single high-quality recommendation. To address it, we introduce efficient exploration strategies that can be incorporated into any BO procedure by occasionally replacing the acquisition query with an exploration query. To validate this approach, we bound the Gaussian process posterior standard deviation over the search space via the fill distance of the queries, which measures the largest region left unexplored. We then use this result to derive upper bounds on the inference regret, i.e., the gap between the global optimum and the function value at the algorithm's returned point. Empirically, these exploration strategies improve the final recommendations of existing BO algorithms on synthetic benchmarks, hyperparameter

translated_title: 具有推断遗憾保证的高斯过程赌博机优化探索策略
translated_abstract: 现有的贝叶斯优化（BO）累积遗憾保证并不一定能刻画算法最终输出的质量。这一差距在含噪声评估的场景下尤为关键，因为此时目标是在算法结束时返回一个高质量的单一推荐。为解决这一问题，我们引入了高效的探索策略，这些策略可以通过偶尔将采集查询替换为探索查询的方式融入任何贝叶斯优化流程中。为验证该方法，我们通过查询点的填充距离（fill distance）来界定高斯过程后验标准差在整个搜索空间上的上界，该距离衡量了尚未被探索的最大区域。随后，我们利用这一结果推导出推断遗憾（即全局最优值与算法返回点处函数值之间的差距）的上界。实证结果表明，这些探索策略在合成基准和超参数优化任务上改进了现有贝叶斯优化算法的最终推荐结果。
tldr: 本文提出了一种通过偶尔将采集查询替换为探索查询即可融入任意贝叶斯优化流程的探索策略，并借助填充距离为高斯过程后验标准差和推断遗憾推导出理论上界，从而保证算法最终推荐结果的质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes exploration strategies that can be incorporated into any Bayesian optimization procedure by occasionally replacing acquisition queries with exploration queries, and derives inference regret upper bounds via fill-distance control of the Gaussian process posterior standard deviation, thereby guaranteeing the quality of the algorithm's final recommendation.
